editorial.blurb: A vibrant Korean fried chicken spot where crispy, tender bird and addictive ddeok-bokki keep locals coming back for late-night cravings and genuine hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit in person rather than ordering online—the system doesn't always reflect updated hours. Ask about the free drink with a Google review, and don't skip the complimentary Cheesling Fries if offered.
